title: koeleria macrantha var. rohlenae
intro: Koeleria macrantha var. rohlenae, commonly known as Roehlena's Koeleria, is a plant species belonging to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Roehlena's Koeleria include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
